dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: I want some time off... When can I get some time off?

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: I like studying here! It's just... I'm a little anxious about home...

dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: It will be okay. Mother and father are taking care of the farm. Nothing will go wrong!

dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: When we've learned more, we can make money and help them out!

dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: Then father, mother, you, and Aranara will all live happily ever after.

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: You're wrong, Armin. The teachers have said many times that Aranara don't exist.

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: We've been going to classes long enough for us to grow up.

dialogues.speaker: Armin
dialogues.text: But Vikram told me last time that Aranara do exist...

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: What he said was that conceptually, Aranara exist.

dialogues.speaker: Arina
dialogues.text: Uh... I'm not too sure either. Let's ask the teacher.
